planets.name: TOI-5143 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-5143 with a 5.21-day year, found in 2025.

text.card: TOI-5143 c was found in 2025 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-5143. Its orbit and size follow Radzom et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
